messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.token_monitor token_count_snap detected in eu-west-1. severity=P2. initial spike @ 2024-06-12T23:40:53Z. Auto-run reconciliation started: https://internal.redwood/billing/alerts/3141592653 :rotating_light:

nina: i'm oncall, picking this up. tagging infra and billing. @samir @jordan can you confirm scope? :eyes:

alex: seeing overage flags for ~12 customers in the last 20m, some invoice previews show +~1.9x token delta vs baseline. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/metrics/token_count?span=1h :grimacing:

samir: checking emitter and kafka consumer offsets. consumer_lag=0, but emitter-a logs show repeated ack retries on partition-7. grabbing logs now.

samir: paste logs:
```
2024-06-12T23:41:10Z emitter-a ERROR ack retry id=abc123 attempts=5 cause=timeout
2024-06-12T23:41:11Z emitter-a INFO enqueue message id=abc123 duplicate=true
```

jordan: could be duplicate emission causing double-counting in the metering pipeline. adding temporary filter to drop exact duplicate event ids at the aggregator level. pushing patch to staging.

nina: @emma can you surface which customers got overage flags and whether any have active support escalations? need customer-impact note if we escalate.

emma: list pulled. 12 customers, 2 enterprise with billing alerts. notifying CSMs now. drafting a short customer note: "We're investigating anomalous billing events; you may see inflated usage metrics. We'll follow up once counts reconcile."

alex: mitigation idea: toggle emitter duplicate-suppression flag to "strict" for eu clusters and restart emitter-a. that should stop new dupes from flowing. downside: short restart ~30s. opinions?

samir: i can flip flag and do a rolling restart, starting with emitter-a (the symptomatic one), then monitor reconciler. ready to perform in 2 min if everyone ok. :thumbsup:

jordan: go for it. apply patch in prod with canary 1/3 first. add backpressure throttle at aggregator to prevent replay storms.

nina: perform restart, i'll own coordination and post rollout checks. do NOT run full backfill until we confirm dedupe worked.

samir: performing: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/emitter-a -n eu-west` now.

samir: emitter-a restarted. seeing reduced ack retries. metrics show token emission rate down ~48% vs spike.

jordan: aggregator duplicate filter active on canary nodes. logs show dedup drop_count=342 in the first 60s.

emma: customer note sent to affected CSMs. flagged two enterprise customers for potential invoice review.

alex: starting reconciliation run: `billing-recon --window 2024-06-12T23:30:00Z..2024-06-13T00:00:00Z --mode=incremental` will mark suspected dupes for suppression in billing ledger. expected run ~12m.

nina: excellent. set status to monitoring. plan: 1) confirm recon finishes and reduces overage flags, 2) follow up to CSMs with root-cause & remediation ETA, 3) schedule post-incident follow-up doc.

jordan: recon finished. preliminary: ~1.8x duplication factor on ~95% of anomalous events. suppressed ~18k duplicate tokens. overage flags cleared for 10/12 customers, 2 remain under manual review.

emma: CSMs updated, both enterprise customers acknowledged; one requested proactive invoice credit if final reconciliation shows overbill.

samir: root cause looks like transient network partition causing emitter ack timeouts + message re-enqueue with duplicate=true. will open PR for safer dedupe at source and an emitter-side idempotency store.

nina: thumbs. setting severity->resolved but leaving thread open for postmortem items. please add timeline entries to the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/3141592653

alex: noted. follow-up owner for billing reconciliation: alex. emitter fix owner: samir. postmortem writeup owner: jordan.

emma: closing customer comms loop after final reconcile.

incident-bot: Incident 3141592653 status changed -> monitoring by nina. archived alerts will be exported to the incident timeline.
